تستنقذون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْقِذُونَ (tastanqiḏūna) /tas.tan.qi.ðuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# تُسْتَنْقَذُونَ (tustanqaḏūna) /tus.tan.qa.ðuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
